run_BulletSim_context_manager: run a pybullet simulation using the BulletSim context manager to connect and load URDF models
test_rendering_benchmark: test pybullet rendering performance by capturing camera images and measuring FPS across multiple runs
create_view_matrix: create a camera view matrix from yaw pitch roll values using computeViewMatrixFromYawPitchRoll
capture_camera_image: capture a camera image with shadow and lighting using getCameraImage and a projection matrix
load_plugin_renderer: load an OpenGL renderer plugin into pybullet using loadPlugin for hardware accelerated rendering
